title: IRAS individual tax e-Filing — YA 2026
summary: File YA 2026 (income earned in 2025) on myTax Portal from 1 Mar through 18 Apr 2026 via Singpass or Singpass Foreign user Account (SFA). Non-residents with Singapore-sourced income must file regardless of amount; first-year EP holders should open myTax once Singpass works.
